items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Actually, I was the first one to work with him with Charlie Ventura when we did that Sherman Hotel College Union thing... And so that’s when we first met him.

ctx.x: A dear, sweet friend of ours and a friend of jazz.

Actually, I was the first one to work with him with Charlie Ventura when we did that Sherman Hotel College Union thing, because he was the emcee. Dave Garroway was the emcee for some of the shows, and he alternated when Dave couldn’t make it. And so that’s when we first met him. You met him then too. And then later on we’ve done a lot of interviews with him.

Went up to his studios and did interviews and talked and he would play the current records and so forth. And he would always come in to a club to see us. And let’s see, two years ago, when we did Jazz Nativity at Orchestra Hall in Chicago, Studs took the place of Charles Kuralt and introduced the show. Now for Christmas, Studs came in, came first to see us, his dear friends, we sat in the room and we just talked about old times and this and that. And he was wearing this old raincoat and a great big red scarf…
